glosses: doorman, porter, gatekeeper (a person who holds open the door at the entrance to a building, summons taxicabs, and provides an element of security; in apartment buildings, he also accepts deliveries and may perform certain concierge type services)
bouncer, chucker-out (a member of security personnel employed by bars, nightclubs, etc to maintain order and deal with patrons who cause trouble)

examples.text: El portero vive en el bajo.
examples.en: The superintendent lives on the ground floor.
Tom was disguised as a janitor.
